# Vocabahn

German vocabulary learning app: a shared AI-enriched dictionary, FSRS spaced-repetition flashcards, and curated courses — built as a mobile-first PWA.

## About this Project
Vocabahn is an "AI-first" language learning platform. It combines traditional spaced-repetition algorithms (FSRS) with deep LLM enrichment to provide a seamless learning experience.

## Tech Stack
- Backend: NestJS 11, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, TanStack Query, GSAP
- Shared: Zod schemas (`packages/shared/`)
